name: hud_background_cursor_set_image_borrowed_refresh_if_changed
description: HudUiBackgroundCursorWidget::SetImageBorrowedAndRefreshIfChanged delegates borrowed image assignment to HudUiWidget and rebuilds the captured cursor background only when the delegated call returns a non-null image.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.

The function is a small wrapper over accepted HudUiWidget::SetImageBorrowedAndInvalidate and HudUiBackgroundCursorWidget::RebuildCapturedImageForCurrentImage behavior; tier S tailcall/register-shape verification is deferred to a coherent HUD widget class pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja HLIL and disassembly at 0x4bfa70 show the function pushing the image argument to HudUiWidget::SetImageBorrowedAndInvalidate, testing the returned pointer, calling HudUiBackgroundCursorWidget::RebuildCapturedImageForCurrentImage only when the return is nonzero, then returning with thiscall stack cleanup.

The dependency frontier for 0x4bfa70 has two direct callees, HudUiWidget::SetImageBorrowedAndInvalidate at 0x4b3e70 and HudUiBackgroundCursorWidget::RebuildCapturedImageForCurrentImage at 0x4bfae0, both accepted at functional-verification mode.

The native smoke verifies the non-null borrowed image path assigns the source image and rebuilds a captured cursor background from the software surface, then verifies the null image path updates the base image to null while skipping a captured-image rebuild.
